item.jaymoskingdoms.wyvern_egg.cold: Cold. Keep it by a fire.
item.jaymoskingdoms.wyvern_egg.ripe: Ripe. Set it down on a block.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wyvern_egg.not_ri: The egg is only %s%% warm. Keep it by a fire a while longer.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wonder_horse.bond: %s doesn't know you well enough yet. Only a horse whose bond with you is full will take a gift like this.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wonder_horse.wind: %s is winded and glides down. It needs the ground to rest.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wonder_horse.rest: %s has got its breath back and can fly again.
